label: Conceptual reproduction of an indistinguishability mechanism, not numeric replication of a paper table.
source_scope: The two-point distributions, finite support, costs, and fixed audit experiment are constructed here; source theorem and table values are not claimed.

analytic.population_band_scope: All distributions with mass 0.5 at demand five and remaining mass anywhere on eight through forty.

analytic_verification.two_world_restriction_is_different: Restricting uncertainty to only A and B gives orders 23 or 24 and regret 12, not 16.
analytic_verification.low_quantile: At costs 1:3, order five has zero regret over the entire population CDF band.

monte_carlo.design: The last k cap-eight records are replaced by cap-forty records within the same fixed N demands; audit placement is independent of outcomes.
monte_carlo.common_random_numbers: The same uniforms are used across worlds, N prefixes, audit allocations, tail completions, and cost settings.
monte_carlo.interval_interpretation: Approximate normal interval for the mean over independent simulation seeds, not an identification or CDF confidence bound.
monte_carlo.audit_cost_interpretation: Historical cost differences include both underage and overage; they can be negative when larger stock also avoids expensive shortages.
monte_carlo.claim_scope: Terminal decisions after fixed observation designs; no monotonic improvement, active-policy regret bound, or business effect is asserted.
